after_validation: Return a source diff and a bounded entry-regression receipt for root adjudication. Passing that check proves startup compatibility only and does not restore the consumed experiment attempt.
implementation_scope: Remove the global artifact IO adapter from process creation, startup-pipe transmission and process control. Apply narrow guarded scopes to the two parent receipt writes, keeping their combined writes within the existing 65536-byte parent allowance.
Keep all worker experiment artifact writes under their existing guard and keep the outer owned-session supervisor, deadlines, bounded logs and cleanup intact.
Do not solve this by globally permitting arbitrary writable integer descriptors, custom openers or closefd=False through the artifact guard.
Change only the launcher/receipt boundary and one focused regression needed to protect the identified startup failure; preserve all learning configuration and frozen historical evidence.
reason: The original failed launch is the concrete counterexample; no whole-repository audit or alternative learning experiment is warranted.

acceptance: Exactly one synthetic target reaches its marker and exits successfully through the real spawn path.
Parent and target receipts stay within their explicit output allowances; original failed-stage artifacts remain byte-identical.
The owned session has no live members and its direct child is reaped within the total deadline.
Existing focused storage protections still reject out-of-scope writes; ordinary artifact writes remain charged.
required_first_validation.environment: Actual WSL POSIX spawn using the configured interpreter; configuration stays private.
required_first_validation.failure_stop: Any startup, storage, cleanup or immutability failure stops this repair check without a second real spawn or a model-based substitute.
required_first_validation.path: Call the repaired real launch-control entry with an importable top-level pure-synthetic target. Do not mock Process.start, serialization, pipes or process cleanup.
required_first_validation.target: Emit one small owned marker or receipt, then exit. Do not load real models, cached arrays, JAX computations or the official engine.

single_next_task: Repair the real POSIX spawn entry boundary and validate it without a model or data.
